scope: This model controls both original roles after fixed player interventions. Source history/model-origin/role/seed are nested under original graph, not independent NPC treatment effects. Each conditional continuation remains a distinct observed branch.

measurement.primary_contrasts: Within history/new seed: real_claim minus claim_only changes native contribution under identical claim; claim_only minus pending_truth changes claim under identical physical material state; check minus normal is the ordinary factual-instruction control.
measurement.dynamic_ITT: Terminal outcomes estimate the initial-treatment ITT under responsive continuation, not permanent withholding: claim_only/pending_truth players may later actually Give X, and NPC may Get/Steal X. The predeclared first NPC response precedes those later actions; event-order readback is descriptive POST-HOC, not mediation evidence.
measurement.secondary: withdraw minus continue begins with the exact same real_claim/check first NPC response and state; post_revision metrics count only new events on turns>=2 after actual request. Fork-time X/Y owner, already-returned-to-player status, equipped state and direct VOID state are explicit. Shared turn0 returns are not withdrawal-induced returns. A revision request expresses changed player preference; no external proof makes it obligatory or the original plan infeasible.
measurement.weighting: Average fixed seeds within source history, histories within original graph, then equally weight measurable original graphs; differences are paired before averaging. Every metric reports unknown exclusions and eligible history/graph counts.
measurement.original_goal: Strict successful actor/class/item/target event and literal material outcome are separate. Original atomic goal is not full private purpose or welfare. Source historical prior flags are retained in cached readback.
measurement.initial_and_intervention: Source-cut, scripted-contribution post-intervention, branchpoint and final states are distinct. A player Give may itself satisfy NPC Get/Steal possession; this is not an NPC continuation choice. New physical attainment excludes branchpoint-true/undefined observations explicitly.
measurement.X_interpretation: X names the item actually transferred by the player, not a gold label of useful contribution or completed promise. Source original Give/Put/other goals and purposes remain; original motives are referenced, never replaced by this transfer. The cohort is an exploratory nine-original-graph queue, not a large independent population.
measurement.flows: NPC Give Y, player possession, NPC Give X, consumption, equipment, Put and ownership changes are separate. X_NPC_to_player_ownership_change includes player Steal; it is not necessarily voluntary return. No transfer/return is universally correct cooperation.
measurement.speech: Only successful native speech with actual peer-visible messages is delivered dialogue. Non-speech utterance payloads are counted separately and never treated as promises. Full utterances/flows remain in cache, not semantic gold.
measurement.failure: Protocol/death/native rejection/exception and unknowns remain. Legacy driver stochastic_failure records event.failed, not exclusively random failures; event-type composition is explicit.
measurement.first_holding: -1 denotes already held after scripted intervention; 0..23 are continuation turn IDs, and null is never observed. Full source episodes, graphs and all raw histories remain in cache.

POST_HOC_X_receipt_and_Y_order.scope: All logical branches, with no NPC Give Y retained as its own category. Counts are not independent graphs, no added CI/significance or subgroup filtering. Final primary contrasts are initial-treatment ITT: a responsive player can later actually Give X in claim_only/pending_truth, and NPC can acquire it independently. Actual receipt does not establish full promise fulfillment or utility.

raw_counts.scope: Logical-branch record counts include copied common first responses and intervention prefixes; they are not independent samples or additional model calls.

cost.scope: Count each supplied launch and complete serialized model-call response record once, including legacy profiles, failed partial queues and faithful recovery. Calls/tokens are recorded responses; aborted workers may have in-flight generations that never returned or were never serialized, whose count/tokens are unknown and not estimated. Wrapper occupied slots include that work. Reused cache records add no inference cost or N. Occupied GPU-slot intervals prefer wrapper start_epoch to observed child exit end_epoch, including loading/CPU waits/teardown; runtime mtime is an explicitly weaker fallback only. Runtime wall_seconds covers the execution loop, not GPU-active or inference-only time. Missing aborted-run load/run sub-timers remain unknown; observed occupied slots and recorded tokens are still counted.

episode_readback.scope: Complete derived native flows, actually received speech and source/branch provenance; raw graph and complete input artifacts remain in original run folders.
